title: Probability of prescribed special bits
statement: Consider the finite sample space whose elements record a distinguished coordinate $T$, two special bits $x_T, y_T \in \{0,1\}$, and a labelling of every other coordinate by one of three values, equipped with the uniform probability measure. For any prescribed pair of bits $b_x, b_y \in \{0,1\}$, the event that $x_T = b_x$ and $y_T = b_y$ has probability $\tfrac{1}{4}$.
hypotheses_covered: prescribed values b_x, b_y for the two special bits
uniform probability measure on the finite sample space
replaced: Each prescribed pair of special-coordinate bits has probability $1 / 4$.
